title: Research: prove P112 rank-five shortening through common support 44
body:
## Summary

Prove a sufficient P112 shortening bound over every characteristic-zero field. After deleting one common support, three residual pieces of binary support rank at most five have root-code intersection dimension at most one:

```diff
- elementary union bound: common support <=41
+ projective A2 fiber bound: common support <=44
```

Only `research/p112-a2-rank5-shortening/` changes. The proof permits dependent pieces and arbitrary coefficients. The new finite premise is the sharp ten-line capacity of a rank-five subset in a full E8 projective A2 fiber. Singleton incidence counting extends the sufficient global threshold. **Threshold 44 is not proved sharp; 45 is only a losing counting control.**

Scientific/submission base: `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`; contribution: `22c7bf316`. The sole live dependency is the source-pinned main-branch root-simplex geometry. Credit Nick Petalas's retained geometry, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154 and the E8/P112 lineage. The [concurrent rank-six A2 investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19003040) shares the singleton mechanism but uses fiber capacity 16 and an actual TWOSIDE profile; this submission has a distinct rank-five/generic scope.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the union allowance gives `78-|S| <=36`, excluding through 41.
  **After:** rank-five fiber capacity 10 gives `2*(78-|S|) <=66`, excluding through 44. Literal ten-line fiber witnesses attain the local capacity; no global sharpness witness is claimed.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes all 1,120 A2 planes, 3,309,747 P112 five-flats, three 2,667-space fiber censuses and eight optimized control groups. A separate subset-span implementation checks 80,730 five-label bases per fiber. Ruff check/format and metadata/pins pass.
- Internal automated peer review found no blocking mathematical issue at identified hashes. It did not rerun the five-flat census. `REVIEW.json` preserves its limits and later formatting/output-guard changes; proof and RESULT hashes are unchanged.

Reproduce from the repository root with a session-owned external TMPDIR:

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -W error -B \
  scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-a2-rank5-shortening
```

No TWOSIDE profile exclusion, full C5, decoder floor, supplier admission or new kappa is claimed. The Weyl-chamber theorem remains a written dependency. Actual caller binding and the 45 boundary remain open. No Lean, Docker, human review or selected-supplier cold replay was performed. Family decision: stop at the scoped lemma. Development used substantial automated assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One new research package. No selected record, shared checker or frozen source changes.
